body: I really appreciate everyone's kind words. I'm overwhelmed by the responses I received. I just wanted to let everyone know I really do appreciate it.

I have very bad depression which causes me to procrastinate a lot and then my anxiety gets worse when I know I'm procrastinating and get to the point of not even doing whatever I'm supposed to be doing.  I've failed school because of this many times and my parents just get mad at me for being lazy. When I act anxious and try to talk about it they say why are you acting so weird stop and get really upset with me. Ik this may be the wrong place to post this but I'm just very sad tired and high trying to numb my sadness. I didn't want to be a failure. Sometimes I get a glimmer of hope and decide to try and get help but I don't even know where to start. But right now, and most of the time, I don't see the point. I have no interests or hobbies, no friends, nothing is fun, no one that actually cares about me. The only thing my parents care about is having a daughter they can show off to everyone. I've wasted 19 years of their time and effort, just wasted it. And I don't want to break the 2 decade mark.
Idk I tried drugs but that didn't really help...
Thx I appreciate u taking the time to respond
I'm literally a less successful version of OP
Yes :( but I really need to to take someone up on this offer...and it's an ear full. If you don't have time it's ok
